original.statement: Cilium CLI must be upgraded to v0.15.0 or later and switched to Helm installation mode to install and manage Cilium v1.16; classic installation mode is no longer supported, and migrating from classic to Helm mode requires uninstalling with classic mode CLI and reinstalling with Helm mode CLI.

decision.reason: [ev-f2e613944dc4] states "Upgrade Cilium CLI to v0.15.0 or later to switch to Helm installation mode to install and manage Cilium v1.16" and that classic mode is not supported with v1.16, which directly sets a minimum Cilium CLI version of >=0.15.0 for managing this release. Cilium CLI is a separate tool that interacts with Cilium, so product-relationship with name cilium-cli and requirement-changed after ">=0.15.0" match the text. The classic-to-Helm reinstall step is a separate migration fact from the same text and does not make this requirement assertion wrong.
